description: Prepares video ads for a product, one per format (vertical 9:16 for Reels and TikTok, square 1:1, wide 16:9), from the product's page (Shopify, Amazon, Etsy or any shop) or its name. Returns the link to Cirrela's product-ad page filled in: the page reads the product when the person taps Import, shows the start images and the cost before anything is spent. This tool fetches nothing and renders nothing. Fits "make an ad for my product", "fais une pub vidéo pour mon produit", "haz un anuncio en vídeo de mi producto", "faça um anúncio em vídeo do meu produto".

language.description: Optional: the page's language, usually the one the person writes in. Default en.

product.description: Or, without a page: the product in a few words.

name: create_ad
title: Prepare a product video ad
